name: Kozmik Cloud Deck - OpenCode
postStartCommand: export BROWSER=true; export OPENCODE_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATE=true; export PATH="$HOME/.opencode/bin:$PATH"; if [ ! -x "$HOME/.opencode/bin/opencode" ]; then (curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash >/tmp/opencode-install.log 2>&1 || true); fi; if [ ! -d "$HOME/.config/opencode/.git" ]; then (git clone https://gitlab.com/Densyakun/config-opencode.git "$HOME/.config/opencode" >/tmp/config-opencode-clone.log 2>&1 || true); else (git -C "$HOME/.config/opencode" pull --ff-only >/tmp/config-opencode-pull.log 2>&1 || true); fi; { while true; do if [ "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:4096/ || echo 000)" = '000' ]; then nohup "$HOME/.opencode/bin/opencode" web --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 4096 >>/tmp/opencode.log 2>&1 & fi; sleep 15; done; } & { MONITOR="$(find /workspaces -maxdepth 3 -name presence-monitor.sh -type f 2>/dev/null | head -n1)"; if [ -z "$MONITOR" ] && [ -f "$HOME/.config/opencode/presence-monitor.sh" ]; then MONITOR="$HOME/.config/opencode/presence-monitor.sh"; fi; if [ -n "$MONITOR" ]; then (nohup bash "$MONITOR" >>/tmp/presence-monitor.log 2>&1 &); fi; }
